scientific_integrity: The result gives only the stated classification. No external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification includes only primitive periods at most four; primality of unrestricted Fermat numbers and special powers-of-three conditions is not resolved. The finite regression cannot establish infinite completeness; the proof provides a symbolic necessary-and-sufficient case analysis. Possible unindexed equivalent work is an originality risk.
title: Exact short-period classification for a shifted largest-prime-factor map
